Union Trust Bank of India
Bank Guarantee Department
BG No: BG/160
Date: 14 Aug 2022
To,
The Employer / Commissioner
Subject: Performance Bond — Water Treatment Works (Tender RFP-132016975)
Dear Sir / Madam,
At the request of M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (the Contractor), we, Union Trust Bank of India,
hereby irrevocably and unconditionally undertake to pay you, on first written demand and without demur,
any sum not exceeding INR 0 (Rupees 0 Only) toward the Contractor's obligations under the captioned
tender.
This guarantee remains in force up to and including 10 May 2025, after which it stands automatically
discharged unless a claim in writing is received by us on or before that date. Our liability is restricted to the
amount stated above. Payment instructions: IFSC KNBX0004417.
Authorised Signatory
Union Trust Bank of India
